```{r}
residuals <- c(variability = "sd_r_average", trend = "abs_trend_average") %>% 
  map(\(r) out_glm$models[[r]]$habitat_controlled %>% DHARMa::simulateResiduals(n = 1000))
  

autocor <- map(residuals, \(r) DHARMa::testSpatialAutocorrelation(r, x = data$X, y = data$Y, plot = F))

residuals_spat <- targets::tar_read(
  residuals_spatial_models_habitat_controlled,
  store = store_in_pipeline()
)

autocor_spat <- map(residuals_spat, \(r) DHARMa::testSpatialAutocorrelation(r, x = data$X, y = data$Y, plot = F))

build_tbl_stats1_autocor(
  autocor,
  autocor_spat
) %>%
    dispatch_format(
      docx_fn = ifelse(running_from_pipeline(), NULL, format_autocor_flex),
      other_fn = format_autocor_kable
    )
```
